# GR Scale

> GR Scale builds fast, modern, mobile-first websites for local service businesses across the United States — HVAC companies, roofers, plumbers, electricians, barbershops, landscapers, cleaners, and other trades. Based in Tampa, Florida; serving nationwide. Founded by Gio Rivera.

## What we do

- Custom website design and builds for local service businesses (live in 7–14 days)
- Website redesigns for outdated or broken sites
- Local SEO and Google Business Profile setup and optimization
- Hosting, maintenance, backups, and updates (monthly plans)
- Landing pages, online booking integration, and lead tracking

## Pricing (transparent, no hidden fees)

- Starter: $500 one-time build, then $99/month (hosting, updates, daily backups, support)
- Growth: $750 one-time build, then $299/month (adds local SEO, Google Business Profile management, monthly reports) — most popular
- Scale: $1,200 one-time build, then $599/month (adds advanced SEO, landing pages, AI chat, reputation management, lead tracking)
- Free website audit before any commitment: we show you what your current site is costing you, no charge, no obligation
- Clients own their websites. Monthly plans cancel anytime with 14 days notice.

## Proof of work

- meloair.net — Melo Air, HVAC company (Tampa, FL)
- lexthebarber.com — Lex The Barber (Orlando, FL)
- 13+ industry demo sites at https://grscales.com/demos

## Why choose GR Scale

- Built specifically for local service businesses that win jobs from Google searches and phone calls
- Fast turnaround: live in 7–14 days
- One point of contact, everything handled: design, build, hosting, SEO
- Straightforward flat pricing published publicly
